struct Attestation
  std::string by
  bool verified
  std::int64_t hop
  std::string program
  std::string host
  std::string user
  std::string exe
  std::int64_t uid
  std::int64_t gid
  std::int64_t pid
  std::string key
  std::string mac
struct Record
  std::int64_t schema
  std::string time
  std::int64_t level
  std::string msg
  std::vector<Attestation> identity
  std::string job
  std::map<std::string, std::string> attrs
struct Page
  PageOutcome outcome
  std::vector<Record> records
  std::string next
  bool at_end
struct HistoryUsage
  std::int64_t retained_bytes
  std::string oldest

  std::optional<std::int64_t> max_retention_ms

  std::string program
struct ApplicationLogResource

  std::string captured_file_key
struct ApplicationLogPage
